plan.name: Systematic Search and Cool in Fridge
plan.strategy: First, search for a mug systematically in cabinets and drawers. Once found, cool it in the fridge and place it on the shelf.
steps: Check cabinets 1 through 9 in order to locate a mug.
If a mug is not found in cabinets, search drawers 1 through 9 next.
Once a mug is located, take it to the fridge.
Place the mug in the fridge to cool it.
After cooling, retrieve the mug from the fridge.
Move the cooled mug to one of the shelves (shelf 1, 2, or 3).
